leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom directive that detects clicks outside a specified element
Initialize and manage a boolean state variable to track the visibility of a dropdown
Bind the custom directive to a template element to handle click-outside events
Configure the directive to toggle the dropdown state when clicking outside the target area
Implement a click handler that updates the dropdown state based on user interaction
Integrate the click-outside detection with a dropdown component to control its visibility
Manipulate the DOM by conditionally rendering dropdown content based on the click-outside state
